name: vault_names
sql: select name, created_at, updated_at from vault.secrets order by name

name: postmatch_alerts_recent
sql: select at, condition, kind, delivered from public.postmatch_alert_log order by at desc limit 5

name: bot_fns
sql: select n.nspname, p.proname from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('ten287_bot','ten280_bot','public') and (p.prosrc ilike '%telegram%') order by 1,2

name: bot_sends_recent
sql: select r.id, r.status_code, r.created from net._http_response r order by r.id desc limit 5

name: cron_jobs
sql: select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job order by jobname

name: wh_rows_recent
sql: select observed_at, match_key, selection, price, change_kind from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where bookmaker ilike '%william%' order by observed_at desc limit 12

name: wh_books_names
sql: select bookmaker, count(*), max(observed_at) from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where observed_at > now()-interval '8 hours' group by 1 order by 1

name: b365_ha
sql: select match_key, count(*) n, count(*) filter (where change_kind='removed') removed, min(observed_at), max(observed_at) from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where market='Home/Away' and bookmaker='bet365' and observed_at >= '2026-09-26T03:55:00Z' group by 1 order by 1
